newsitem.title: FRANCE: Seven dead in light aircraft crash in France.
newsitem.headline: Seven dead in light aircraft crash in France.

text.p: Seven people were killed when the light aircraft in which they were travelling crashed on Thursday in central France, local authorities said.

Authorities said the twin-engined Cessna 121 went down at around 11 a.m. (1000 GMT) near the town of Donzeil in the central Creuse department. It was on its way from Geneva to the southwestern French city of Bordeaux.
The private aircraft was owned by the Swiss firm Jetcom, with offices at the Geneva airport, the authorities said.
